prompts.title: Build charts, data stories and infographics with InsightCharts
prompts.description: Choose the right InsightCharts component for the user's data, install the library and build a finished figure in the user's React project.

prompts.title: Make charts accessible
prompts.description: Every chart in the user's project has a title that states its fact, an accurate text alternative, a data table where exact values matter, and readable contrast.

prompts.title: Link charts so a click on one filters the others
prompts.description: Two or more charts share one dataset inside InsightData, and clicking a mark in a selectable chart filters the other charts.

prompts.title: Make InsightCharts follow the project's dark mode
prompts.description: Every chart matches the colour mode of the page around it, or the mode the user asked for, with no wrong-mode chart after a theme switch.

prompts.title: Connect data to an InsightCharts chart
prompts.description: The chart reads the user's data source directly, with any reshaping done by JSON transforms, and shows loading and error states for remote data.

prompts.title: Go beyond a component's props with ECharts options
prompts.description: The chart has the ECharts setting or custom form the user needs, and it still takes its colours, text and behaviour from InsightCharts.

prompts.title: Add export to charts and posters
prompts.description: Readers can save a chart as PNG, JPEG, SVG, PDF, CSV or JSON, or a whole poster or social card as one PNG, from a menu or from the user's own button.

prompts.title: Add a title, a highlight and annotations to a chart
prompts.description: The chart has a title that states one fact with its number, the entity in the title is highlighted, and at most three annotations mark what the reader needs.

prompts.title: Use icons in charts and figures
prompts.description: Every icon prop in the user's charts holds a built-in icon name or a valid custom path, and unit charts state what one icon stands for.

prompts.title: Choose and build the right InsightCharts component
prompts.description: The user's data is drawn with the component level that fits the job, with a title that states one fact, a highlight and a source.

prompts.title: Build an infographic poster
prompts.description: One designed poster in the user's project, drawn by an infographic template or the poster frame, with the user's data, a poster theme and a source line.

prompts.title: Install InsightCharts in this project
prompts.description: The package (or the copied component source) is installed, a chart imports and renders, and the project typechecks.

prompts.title: Emit, validate and render a JSON spec
prompts.description: A JSON spec that passes the schema and renders through Insight in the user's project.

prompts.title: Render a first InsightCharts chart
prompts.description: One chart of the user's data renders with a title that states one fact, a subtitle, a source and a highlight.

prompts.title: Build a step-by-step data story with Scrolly
prompts.description: One chart stays in place and changes state as the reader scrolls, swipes or steps through a list of short text steps.

prompts.title: Build a whole page from a template
prompts.description: A complete page in the user's project rendered by one report-style template, with the user's titles, figures and charts in its props.

prompts.title: Theme InsightCharts to match a brand
prompts.description: Every chart in the project uses the user's colours and fonts in light and dark mode, set in one place.

prompts.title: Build a scroll story like the ones in the gallery
prompts.description: A scroll story in the user's project that pins one chart and changes one prop at every step, modelled on a story from the gallery.

prompts.title: Draw one chart from a CSV file
prompts.description: Loads a CSV file, chooses a chart form, and renders one chart with a title that states one fact from the data.

prompts.title: Build a row of key numbers
prompts.description: Renders two to eight key figures with their changes as a stat row or a KPI grid.

prompts.title: Write an executive brief
prompts.description: Builds a one-page brief with a headline, key figures, a hero chart, supporting charts and recommended actions.

prompts.title: Build a scroll story
prompts.description: Pins one chart and changes one prop at each step as the reader scrolls, swipes or steps through the text.

prompts.title: Build a cross-filtered explorer
prompts.description: Draws two to four charts over one dataset so that a click on one chart filters the others.

prompts.title: Build an infographic poster
prompts.description: Draws one designed poster from a JSON spec with an infographic template and a poster theme.

prompts.title: Restyle charts to a brand theme
prompts.description: Applies a brand's colours and fonts to every InsightCharts component in a project, in light and dark mode.

prompts.title: Convert a Recharts or Chart.js chart
prompts.description: Replaces an existing Recharts or Chart.js chart with the matching InsightCharts component and a title that states one fact.

prompts.title: Getting started for agents
prompts.description: The steps an AI coding agent follows to install InsightCharts and render a first chart in a React project.

prompts.title: Set up your agent
prompts.description: The commands and configuration that give Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any other agent the InsightCharts skill, registry and reference files.

prompts.title: The agent workflow
prompts.description: The seven steps an agent follows to turn data into a finished InsightCharts figure, with what to check at each step.

prompts.title: Choosing a component
prompts.description: How to choose a level and a component for a dataset, with a decision table of all the components and the poster primitives.

prompts.title: Writing rules for agents
prompts.description: The rules for every title, subtitle, callout, annotation label and story step an agent writes, with examples and a self-check list.

prompts.title: JSON specs
prompts.description: How an agent writes an InsightCharts component as a JSON spec, validates it against the JSON Schema and renders it with the Insight component.

prompts.description: Ready-to-copy prompts that tell an agent how to do eight common jobs with InsightCharts.
